none: PAS LIN-944EE5: Silver Roman finger ring inscribed 'TOT'
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver finger ring, Henig Type XI. The ring has a deep channel running inside either edge. The shoulders are D-shaped in cross-section. The bezel is flat and has a vertically incised line to either side. There are seven punched dots aligned vertically just inside either line, and three further dots down the centre. The bezel is inscribed 'TOT'; the middle dot in the central band of three forms the letter 'o' in the inscription. The letter 'T's are formed by simple lines although unusually in this case the lower terminals are extended on the interior.
